title: Virginia Winery Excursion by Luxury Vehicle Three wineries
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
This excursion is not wheelchair accessible
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Let us take you through the beautiful Virginia countryside in a luxury vehicle as we introduce you various wineries of the old dominion state
Nestled in the Northern Virginia heartland acres of vineyards sprinkled with wineries along country roads. 
We will drive you to a trio of distinct wineries that capture the essence of the mid-south
